description:
Retype issue ids in the document, archive, item and validate commands.

## Background

`commands/document.rs` holds 74 production issue-id references and 17 raw-id signatures, `commands/validate.rs` 41 references and 5 signatures, and `commands/archive.rs` and `commands/item.rs` a few each. `commands/validate.rs:248,262` matches ids inline, and `commands/validate.rs:1055` truncates a short id with a literal length. The archive tests pass a short prefix to `preview_archive_container` (`commands/archive.rs:2242`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No struct field, enum field or function parameter in `commands/document.rs`, `commands/archive.rs`, `commands/item.rs` or `commands/validate.rs` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Executor methods in this family take `&IssueId` and resolve no prefixes; callers that hold full ids, such as templates, batch creation and tests, pass them directly.
- [hard] REQ-03: No inline id-prefix match remains in this family, and short ids come only from `short_id()`.
- [hard] REQ-04: No production `IssueIdPrefix` parse and no production `resolve_issue_id` call remains in `commands/document.rs` or `commands/validate.rs`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Document-family commands carry typed issue ids
